prayerExcerpt.en-US: Denying ourselves and following Christ, may we merit to reach the heavenly realms on high.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Renunciando a nós mesmos e seguindo o Cristo, mereçamos chegar felizes ao reino celestial.

meta.face: A very old but vigorous hermit of about seventy-five with a LONG face under a massive, high BALD dome — a broad, strongly furrowed forehead, grey-white brows KNIT DOWNWARD over deep-set, penetrating grey eyes with a searching, severe intensity, a long, strong, slightly hooked nose, sunken cheeks under the beard, a firm mouth half-hidden; a thin fringe of white hair low at the back of the head; a long, wavy, white beard falling in separate strands to mid-chest; the gaze fixed and searching, not gentle.
meta.basis: Fra Angelico's fresco at San Marco shows him with a bald dome, a long white beard, knit brows and a keen, severe gaze, in the white Camaldolese habit; Sacchi painted his vision of monks in white climbing a ladder to heaven. He died very old in 1027. The knit brows, hooked nose and severity keep him apart from the gentler white-bearded elders.
